reviews.text:
S.Honey review)
While taking a walk, an orange sign caught my eye, so I went in.
Overall, the interior is neatly decorated in white and orange.
There are places to drink and go, but takeout seems to be the norm (maybe not).
As if to prove it, when you open the door and enter, a kiosk next to the counter welcomes you to order.
I tend to buy 1 liter iced coffee of the day or 1 liter iced Americano.
If you like iced coffee, buy one and make it strong enough to drink 2-3 times. It's delicious.
You can also create coupons, and I saw on Naver that you get one raw chocolate brownie as a gift for every 10th order.
The owner seemed to have received a sudden large order today and asked for his understanding and asked us to wait.
I thought you might be distracted, so I said, ‘I’m fine, take your time.’
I sat down and waited for the intestine soup I ate earlier to digest.
After the bulk order was completed, the owner seemed to be a little concerned when he gave me 1 liter.
He gave me a raw chocolate brownie as a gift.
I took a bite of the brownie as sweet as the owner's heart and took a sip of the iced coffee.
It feels like it recharges the energy you will need in the afternoon, as well as the energy you will need later on Friday night.
The taste is not only delicious, but it is also a taste that warms your body and mind in this late winter.
